ABOUT THE PRACTICE

Tools changeDirection remains

I’m Logan Huynh, an AI video creator working between cinematic storytelling, commercial clarity and visual experimentation.

AI IS THE MEDIUM · FEELING IS THE RESULT
I use AI as a production medium—not the idea itself

The value is not generating more images. It is knowing what belongs, what distracts and what the audience should feel next.

That means concept before prompting, direction before volume, and editing before spectacle.

01 / PRINCIPLES

Three filters
Every decision

A simple system keeps ambitious visuals from becoming empty decoration.

01 / CLARITY

Can it be understood?

The audience should know where to look, what matters and why the story is moving.

02 / INTENT

Does it belong?

Every frame, movement and transition must support the central idea—not merely show capability.

03 / FEELING

Will it stay?

The final test is emotional: what remains with someone after the film ends?

02 / PROCESS

Structure for
the unexpected

The process stays disciplined enough to deliver, and open enough to discover something better.

Collaboration begins with the decision the film must influence. From there, references become rules, tests become shots and shots become a deliberate sequence.

01

Brief

Audience, objective, constraints and success.

02

Concept

One central thought, written before it is visualised.

03

Worldbuilding

Characters, environments, camera language and motion tests.

04

Final delivery

Edit, sound, colour, formats and a clean handoff.

03 / TOOLKIT

Flexible tools
Consistent taste

The stack adapts to the project. The visual standard does not.
